scope.separation: Independent author-side semantic review by a separate review lane. Every listed node predicate/evidence criterion and outgoing target predicate/context was inspected. No repository changes, external invitations, institutional approval, real incident evidence authentication or independent implementation exchange is claimed. Same-author expected scenarios and structural validity were not treated as independent semantic evidence.
scope.acceptMeaning: Accept means the bounded public investigative proposition/route is sensible under its declared evidence prerequisites; it is not universal domain coverage, runtime certification or real-evidence proof. SourceGuardDependencies identify known upstream evaluator repairs without conflating a sound edge definition with an invalid source assessment.
scope.toolsBusinessBoundary: No reviewed node or edge requires execution of a mail API/tool, selection of an operational response, business approval, policy authorization or actor-intent decision. Observing mail API/audit/configuration/session/collection records is legitimate public investigation.
limitations: No real provider logs were acquired or authenticated.

findings.problem: The profile evaluator accepts a same-origin indexed copy as independent validation when Q147 is entered directly. The alternate search rejects that same copy, so the new independent-validation lead bypasses a real prerequisite.
findings.proposedRepair: Enforce independent record/origin separation in the independentValidation role itself, preserve the primary origin/context, and fail unresolved if separation cannot be assessed. Keep readiness evidence with the selected transition.

findings.problem: A route starting at Q147 validates the independent record but Q224 silently selects primary material. An independent opened operation is then assessed using a rejected primary denied observation, yielding unknown despite usable independent evidence.
findings.proposedRepair: Carry the explicitly selected record/group from independent validation through independent classification and scope; direct resumption must independently identify the correct selected evidence rather than default to primary.

findings.problem: The base/restored matcher and exclusion routine compare only nominal timestamps. A delivery record just outside the interval whose clock uncertainty overlaps it is returned as no-match and supports a false bounded exclusion.
findings.proposedRepair: Assess timestamp uncertainty against [start,end) before match/no/exclusion: wholly in can match, wholly out can be excluded from this search, overlap or absent unresolved clock basis remains unknown. Reuse the more conservative profile clock handling and preserve explicit source clock limits.

findings.problem: Profile corroboration admits independent witnesses from a different or profile-incompatible evidence facet. Base restored corroboration checks the facet; profile corroboration omits it.
findings.proposedRepair: Require each eligible independent witness to be explicitly bound to the fixed corroboration facet and compatible with the selected profile before its event discriminator can contribute.

findings.problem: Profile retention accepts a focus labeled assessed with no nonterminal retained assessment of that focus. A Q5 match row alone can make authentication pathways appear assessed.
findings.proposedRepair: For an assessed focus, require retained applicable nonterminal focus evidence with exact qualified IDs/context; otherwise retain the focus as open or answer unknown. Preserve all previous answers.

findings.problem: Forty-three base Email continuation edges terminate at a question naming a different evidence focus from the source, such as a refuted collaboration hypothesis leading to process-ancestry retention. Metadata asks to preserve source answers but also introduces an unrelated terminal-focus open question.
findings.proposedRepair: Make retention explicitly apply to the incoming source focus and preserve its bound context. Use an explicit terminal context adapter or a source-focus parameterized prompt; do not invent an unrelated open investigation merely to fit a historical endpoint. Profile-qualified terminal wording already provides the appropriate direction.

findings.problem: The mailbox-rule profile says the named rule operation but binds only mailboxId+ruleId. findings.proposedRepair: Obtain a domain review of operation identity. Bind an operation ID or a declared operation discriminator across primary/independent context; otherwise narrow the proposition and require an explicit operation relationship before claiming same-operation corroboration.
